t: This is a blue plaque on Russell Square, in Bloomsbury, marking number 23. It commemorates Lilian Lindsay, who lived from 1871 to 1960. She was a dentist, a dental historian, a librarian and an author. Lindsay was the first qualified woman dentist in Britain, which is why she is remembered here. She also became the first female president of the British Dental Association. She was awarded a CBE and was a Fellow of the Society of Antiquaries.
